Class CardCellFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.view.gui.widgets.CardCellFactory
public final class CardCellFactory extends Object
Factory for reusable JavaFX nodes: cards, offer tiles, the turn order tile, the tribe deck, and the player/tribe summary.

All factory methods return a self-contained Node (or a subtype) so they can be added to any parent. Card images are loaded by CardImageCache; tile images by TileImageCache. Both fall back to readable text placeholders if the image is missing.

Selectability is opt-in: passing a non-null onClick consumer makes the node interactive (.selectable CSS class) and wires the mouse handler. Tile cells additionally apply .placed when occupied.

    • buildTile

      public static javafx.scene.layout.StackPane buildTile(OfferTileSnapshot tile, Consumer<Character> onClick)
      Builds an offer tile cell. If the tile is occupied, a coloured totem is overlaid in the bottom-right corner. The cell is always shown (occupied or not) so the player sees the full offer track; the onClick consumer is invoked even on occupied tiles so the controller can show a "tile already occupied" message — making the validation visible rather than swallowed.
      Parameters:
      tile - snapshot of the offer tile
      onClick - if non-null, invoked with the tile letter on click (works on both free and occupied tiles)

    • buildTotemImage

      public static javafx.scene.Node buildTotemImage(TotemColour colour, double height)
      Builds a totem visual using the carved-stone PNG asset, scaled to the given height. Returns an ImageView when the asset is available; falls back to buildTotemBadge(TotemColour, double) (a coloured circle of comparable size) when the asset is missing.
      Parameters:

      height - target on-screen height in pixels

    • buildTurnOrderTile

      public static javafx.scene.layout.StackPane buildTurnOrderTile(TurnOrderTileSnapshot snap)
      Builds the Turn Order Tile as a vertical card with the player-count artwork as background and totems positioned at the centre of each physical box on the artwork.

      Box centres are pre-measured per player count (see TURN_BOX_Y_FRACTIONS); the image is rendered at fixed TURN_TILE_W×TURN_TILE_H so layout is deterministic.

      If the artwork is missing the method falls back to a procedural vertical strip of position cells with the same numPlayers positions, food bonuses and totems.
